headline: Chinese Stock Market Slips Into Bear Market Amid Fading AI Optimism
summary: China's stock market slipped into bear-market territory as earlier optimism driven by artificial intelligence and technology growth gave way to valuation concerns.
why: Transitions into bear market territory signal a loss of investor confidence across major technology and growth sectors.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Fading enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and broader growth concerns weigh heavily on domestic technology valuations.

why_moved: A cumulative drop exceeding 20% from recent highs officially places the index in a bear market as growth expectations deflate.
